description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for user data retrieval within the 'Conduit' application. It contains a request 'Query' to fetch user details based on username, a validator for the query, and a handler that processes the request by querying a database context ('ConduitContext'), mapping the data to a user model, generating a JWT token, and returning an envelope with user info.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: Contains the request, validator, and handler for retrieving user details by username.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the 'Query' by fetching user data from the database, mapping it, generating a token, and returning it encapsulated in a 'UserEnvelope'.
